overall_summary: The channel shows clear early traction for 'self respect' topics, specifically involving digital boundaries and modern breakup micro-actions (e.g., chat lists, pinned messages, typing deletes). However, absolute view counts are low (mostly under 50 views), and engagement (likes/comments) is near zero, indicating low sample size and early algorithm discovery phase. Confidence is moderate-low; we must double down on the winning digital boundary niche while testing a slightly different emotional hook.

winning_patterns.evidence: Videos focusing on WhatsApp/phone interactions like pinning chats, checking last seen, or removing numbers (e.g., rwOUYo_hayQ with 41 views, AfaLxMy6FMY with 41 views) outperform broad emotional statements.
winning_patterns.action: Continue using everyday digital interface triggers (mute, archive, block, clear history) as the starting point for emotional stories.

weak_patterns.pattern: Abstract or time-based night thoughts without specific physical actions
weak_patterns.evidence: Videos like 'रात के ख्याल और अधूरा इंतजार' (5 views) and 'रात के दो बजे और ओवरथिंकिंग' (12 views) performed significantly worse than concrete boundary-setting actions.
weak_patterns.action: Avoid vague late-night melancholic concepts unless tied directly to a tangible everyday trigger.

next_video.concept: Turning off read receipts (blue ticks) permanently not to hide from them, but to finally choose your own peace of mind over their attention.
next_video.opening_direction: ब्लू टिक्स हमेशा के लिए ऑफ करते वक्त
next_video.twist_direction: शुरुआत में डर था कि उनका मैसेज दिखेगा नहीं, पर अब एहसास हुआ कि अब इंतज़ार करने की मजबूरी भी खत्म हो गई है।
next_video.reason: Previous successful uploads around the evening or morning slots (like rwOUYo_hayQ and AfaLxMy6FMY) hit higher relative views. This captures users wrapping up their day and checking phones.

experiment: Testing a slightly more empowering post-breakup micro-action (turning off read receipts permanently) instead of deleting/blocking, to check if positive self-worth retains attention better than grievance.
